Game Overview

In Slime Clicker, the core idea is straightforward: immerse yourself in the endless battle against gooey hordes in Slime Clicker. Click your way to victory by defeating an unending wave of slimes. Upgrade your gear, bolster your defenses, and hone your skills in this addictive, strategic challenge. Outlast the tide and reclaim the land from sticky chaos!
